def my_cad_function(args):
    import cadquery as cq
    
    shape = cq.importers.importStep(args["input_file"])   # ALWAYS load the input
    base = shape.val() if hasattr(shape, "val") else shape

    # --- Resolve and print referenced faces by index (sanity vs geometry index) ---
    faces = base.Faces()
    edges = base.Edges()
    print(f"BASE: faces={len(faces)} edges={len(edges)} solids={len(base.Solids())}")
    
    ref_face_idxs = [10, 7, 8, 13, 17]
    for i in ref_face_idxs:
        try:
            f = faces[i]
            c = f.Center()
            a = f.Area()
            n = f.normalAt()  # no args
            print(f"RESOLVED FACE #{i}: center={[round(c.x,3), round(c.y,3), round(c.z,3)]} area={round(a,3)} normal={[round(n.x,3), round(n.y,3), round(n.z,3)]}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"RESOLVED FACE #{i}: ERROR {e}")

    # --- Target numbers explicitly named by the sub-goal ---
    anchor_target = cq.Vector(63.0, 0.0, 10.5)
    contact_target = cq.Vector(72.75, 0.0, 14.0)
    gate_width_y = 6.0          # spans Y=-3..3
    gate_thickness = 2.0        # in X-Z plane (thickness direction is in XZ)
    max_x = 75.75
    max_abs_y = 8.188
    max_z = 15.0

    print("TARGETS:", {
        "anchor_target": [anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z],
        "contact_target": [contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z],
        "gate_width_y": gate_width_y,
        "gate_thickness": gate_thickness,
        "bbox_limits": {"x<=": max_x, "|y|<=": max_abs_y, "z<=": max_z}
    })

    # --- Build cantilever gate as an oriented box (length along anchor->contact, width along global Y) ---
    v = contact_target - anchor_target
    L_nom = v.Length
    if L_nom < 1e-6:
        print("ERROR: anchor and contact targets are coincident; aborting edit")
        return base

    xDir = v.normalized()  # beam direction in XZ plane
    yAxis_world = cq.Vector(0, 1, 0)

    # Small extensions for robust fusing while staying within endpoint tolerance
    start_ext = 0.2
    end_ext = 0.2

    def build_gate(start_ext_local, end_ext_local):
        origin = anchor_target - xDir.multiply(start_ext_local)
        L = L_nom + start_ext_local + end_ext_local
        # Plane: x along gate, plane normal along global Y so local Z == global Y (width direction)
        pln = cq.Plane(origin=(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z), xDir=(xDir.x, xDir.y, xDir.z), normal=(0, 1, 0))
        print(f"GATE PLANE: origin={[round(origin.x,3), round(origin.y,3), round(origin.z,3)]} xDir={[round(xDir.x,6), round(xDir.y,6), round(xDir.z,6)]} normal=[0,1,0]")
        gate_wp = cq.Workplane(pln)
        # box dims are (x=length, y=thickness, z=width). Local z is global Y.
        gate_solid = gate_wp.box(L, gate_thickness, gate_width_y, centered=(False, True, True)).val()
        return gate_solid, origin, L

    gate, origin, L = build_gate(start_ext, end_ext)

    # Achieved endpoints along the gate centerline (start/end extremes along xDir)
    achieved_anchor = origin
    achieved_contact = origin + xDir.multiply(L)
    dA = (achieved_anchor - anchor_target).Length
    dC = (achieved_contact - contact_target).Length

    print("GATE ENDPOINT CHECK (attempt 1):")
    print(f"  achieved_anchor={[round(achieved_anchor.x,3), round(achieved_anchor.y,3), round(achieved_anchor.z,3)]}  target={[anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z]}  delta={round(dA,3)}")
    print(f"  achieved_contact={[round(achieved_contact.x,3), round(achieved_contact.y,3), round(achieved_contact.z,3)]}  target={[contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z]}  delta={round(dC,3)}")

    if dA > 0.5 or dC > 0.5:
        print("WARNING: Endpoint delta > 0.5 mm; rebuilding with zero extensions")
        start_ext = 0.0
        end_ext = 0.0
        gate, origin, L = build_gate(start_ext, end_ext)
        achieved_anchor = origin
        achieved_contact = origin + xDir.multiply(L)
        dA = (achieved_anchor - anchor_target).Length
        dC = (achieved_contact - contact_target).Length
        print("GATE ENDPOINT CHECK (attempt 2):")
        print(f"  achieved_anchor={[round(achieved_anchor.x,3), round(achieved_anchor.y,3), round(achieved_anchor.z,3)]}  target={[anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z]}  delta={round(dA,3)}")
        print(f"  achieved_contact={[round(achieved_contact.x,3), round(achieved_contact.y,3), round(achieved_contact.z,3)]}  target={[contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z]}  delta={round(dC,3)}")

    # --- Fuse gate onto the single solid body ---
    out = base.fuse(gate)

    # --- Self-check: isolate added material and print its placement ---
    try:
        added = out.cut(base)
        bb_added = added.BoundingBox()
        c_added = added.Center()
        print("ADDED MATERIAL:")
        print(f"  center={[round(c_added.x,3), round(c_added.y,3), round(c_added.z,3)]}")
        print(f"  bbox: xmin={round(bb_added.xmin,3)} xmax={round(bb_added.xmax,3)} ymin={round(bb_added.ymin,3)} ymax={round(bb_added.ymax,3)} zmin={round(bb_added.zmin,3)} zmax={round(bb_added.zmax,3)}")
        print("  bbox limit deltas:")
        print(f"    xmax-max_x = {round(bb_added.xmax - max_x,3)} (must be <=0 to stay within existing bbox)")
        print(f"    max(|y|)-max_abs_y = {round(max(abs(bb_added.ymin), abs(bb_added.ymax)) - max_abs_y,3)} (must be <=0)")
        print(f"    zmax-max_z = {round(bb_added.zmax - max_z,3)} (must be <=0)")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ADDED MATERIAL: could not compute out.cut(base): {e}")

    # Report achieved anchor/contact explicitly (as requested)
    print("ACHIEVED GATE COORDINATES:")
    print(f"  anchor={[round(achieved_anchor.x,3), round(achieved_anchor.y,3), round(achieved_anchor.z,3)]}")
    print(f"  contact={[round(achieved_contact.x,3), round(achieved_contact.y,3), round(achieved_contact.z,3)]}")

    return out

def my_cad_function(args):
    import cadquery as cq

    shape = cq.importers.importStep(args["input_file"])   # ALWAYS load the input
    base = shape.val() if hasattr(shape, "val") else shape

    def bb_str(bb):
        return {
            "xmin": round(bb.xmin, 3), "xmax": round(bb.xmax, 3),
            "ymin": round(bb.ymin, 3), "ymax": round(bb.ymax, 3),
            "zmin": round(bb.zmin, 3), "zmax": round(bb.zmax, 3),
        }

    print(f"BASE: faces={len(base.Faces())} edges={len(base.Edges())} solids={len(base.Solids())}")
    bb0 = base.BoundingBox()
    print("BASE bbox:", bb_str(bb0))

    # --- Targets explicitly named by the sub-goal ---
    anchor_target = cq.Vector(63.0, 0.0, 10.5)
    contact_target = cq.Vector(72.75, 0.0, 14.0)
    print("TARGETS:", {
        "anchor_target": [anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z],
        "contact_target": [contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z],
        "requested_Y_span": [-3.0, 3.0],
        "requested_Z_max": 15.0,
        "bbox_limits": {"X<=": 75.75, "|Y|<=": 8.188, "Z<=": 15.0},
    })

    # Recompute nominal gate axis (for reporting endpoints later)
    v = contact_target - anchor_target
    if v.Length < 1e-9:
        print("ERROR: anchor and contact are coincident; returning unmodified")
        return base
    xDir = v.normalized()

    # --- We are FIXING the existing gate: trim its slight Y and Z overhangs locally near the hook end ---
    # Gate bbox from QA (previous attempt): min [62.474, -3.314, 4.292] max [75.75, 3.314, 15.009]
    # We'll trim only in a localized X window to avoid touching the handle.
    x_min, x_max = 62.0, 78.0
    x_len = x_max - x_min

    def make_box_from_corner(corner_xyz, size_xyz):
        (ox, oy, oz) = corner_xyz
        (sx, sy, sz) = size_xyz
        pln = cq.Plane(origin=(ox, oy, oz), xDir=(1, 0, 0), normal=(0, 0, 1))
        return cq.Workplane(pln).box(sx, sy, sz, centered=(False, False, False)).val()

    # Diagnostic: local bbox around the hook mouth region BEFORE trim
    region = make_box_from_corner((x_min, -6.0, 0.0), (x_len, 12.0, 20.0))
    try:
        loc0 = base.intersect(region)
        bb_loc0 = loc0.BoundingBox()
        print("MATCH CHECK (hook-end region BEFORE):", bb_str(bb_loc0))
    except Exception as e:
        print("MATCH CHECK: could not intersect for local bbox (before):", e)

    # Tools to remove anything with Y>3, Y<-3, and Z>15 within the hook-end window
    tool_y_pos = make_box_from_corner((x_min, 3.0, 0.0), (x_len, 60.0, 30.0))     # y: 3..63
    tool_y_neg = make_box_from_corner((x_min, -63.0, 0.0), (x_len, 60.0, 30.0))   # y: -63..-3
    tool_z_top = make_box_from_corner((x_min, -10.0, 15.0), (x_len, 20.0, 30.0))  # z: 15..45

    print("SELECTED: 3 cutting solids for trimming existing gate extents (local hook-end window)")

    out = base
    # Apply cuts; if a cut doesn't intersect, it should be a no-op but still valid
    for name, tool in [("trim_Y_pos", tool_y_pos), ("trim_Y_neg", tool_y_neg), ("trim_Z_top", tool_z_top)]:
        try:
            out2 = out.cut(tool)
            # Report if anything was actually removed by this cut
            removed = out.cut(out2)
            vol = removed.Volume() if removed is not None else 0.0
            bb = removed.BoundingBox() if removed is not None else None
            print(f"CUT STEP {name}: removed_volume={round(vol, 6)} bbox={bb_str(bb) if bb else None}")
            out = out2
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"CUT STEP {name}: ERROR during cut: {e}")

    bb1 = out.BoundingBox()
    print("OUT bbox:", bb_str(bb1))
    print("OUT bbox checks:", {
        "zmax_minus_15": round(bb1.zmax - 15.0, 6),
        "ymin_plus_3": round(bb1.ymin + 3.0, 6),
        "ymax_minus_3": round(bb1.ymax - 3.0, 6),
    })

    # Diagnostic: local bbox around the hook mouth region AFTER trim
    try:
        loc1 = out.intersect(region)
        bb_loc1 = loc1.BoundingBox()
        print("MATCH CHECK (hook-end region AFTER):", bb_str(bb_loc1))
    except Exception as e:
        print("MATCH CHECK: could not intersect for local bbox (after):", e)

    # Self-check: what was removed overall (should match the small Y/Z overhangs)
    try:
        removed_all = base.cut(out)
        bb_removed = removed_all.BoundingBox()
        c_removed = removed_all.Center()
        print("REMOVED MATERIAL (overall):")
        print(f"  center={[round(c_removed.x,3), round(c_removed.y,3), round(c_removed.z,3)]}")
        print("  bbox:", bb_str(bb_removed))
    except Exception as e:
        print("REMOVED MATERIAL: could not compute base.cut(out):", e)

    # Report achieved anchor/contact coordinates (measured along a probe intersect where possible)
    # Probe around the intended gate centerline
    try:
        L_nom = v.Length
        start_back = 0.6  # cover the prior ~0.2mm start extension + some fuse overlap
        L_probe = L_nom + 1.2
        origin = anchor_target - xDir.multiply(start_back)
        pln = cq.Plane(origin=(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z), xDir=(xDir.x, xDir.y, xDir.z), normal=(0, 1, 0))
        probe = cq.Workplane(pln).box(L_probe, 1.0, 1.0, centered=(False, True, True)).val()
        inter = out.intersect(probe)
        verts = inter.Vertices()
        print(f"SELECTED: {len(verts)} vertices from centerline probe intersection (for endpoint check)")
        if len(verts) > 0:
            params = []
            for vv in verts:
                p = vv.Center()
                params.append((p - anchor_target).dot(xDir))
            tmin, tmax = min(params), max(params)
            achieved_anchor = anchor_target + xDir.multiply(tmin)
            achieved_contact = anchor_target + xDir.multiply(tmax)
            dA = (achieved_anchor - anchor_target).Length
            dC = (achieved_contact - contact_target).Length
            print("ACHIEVED GATE COORDINATES (from probe):")
            print(f"  anchor={[round(achieved_anchor.x,3), round(achieved_anchor.y,3), round(achieved_anchor.z,3)]}  target={[anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z]}  delta={round(dA,3)}")
            print(f"  contact={[round(achieved_contact.x,3), round(achieved_contact.y,3), round(achieved_contact.z,3)]}  target={[contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z]}  delta={round(dC,3)}")
            if dA > 0.5 or dC > 0.5:
                print("WARNING: endpoint delta > 0.5mm after trimming (should not happen); consider rebuild next iteration")
        else:
            print("ACHIEVED GATE COORDINATES: could not probe-intersect; reporting intended line endpoints")
            print(f"  intended_anchor={ [anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z] }")
            print(f"  intended_contact={ [contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z] }")
    except Exception as e:
        print("Endpoint probe check failed:", e)
        print("ACHIEVED GATE COORDINATES: reporting intended line endpoints")
        print(f"  intended_anchor={ [anchor_target.x, anchor_target.y, anchor_target.z] }")
        print(f"  intended_contact={ [contact_target.x, contact_target.y, contact_target.z] }")

    return out

                f"  face#{i}: area={round(a,3)} center={[round(c.x,3), round(c.y,3), round(c.z,3)]} normal={[round(n.x,3), round(n.y,3), round(n.z,3)]}"
            )

    # --- Build local trimming cutters to fix ONLY the gate overshoot ---
    # We do NOT apply global y clamps (would cut the whole handle). Instead, we cut only in the hook-mouth region.
    # Known problems to fix:
    #   (1) Z overshoot: zmax 15.009 -> must be <=15.0
    #   (2) Y overshoot: gate spans about [-3.314, 3.314] -> must be within [-3.0, 3.0]

    def make_box_from_minmax(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax):
        dx, dy, dz = (xmax - xmin), (ymax - ymin), (zmax - zmin)
        wp = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane.XY())
        b = wp.box(dx, dy, dz, centered=(False, False, False)).translate((xmin, ymin, zmin)).val()
        return b

    # Region around the gate/hook mouth where the hook thickness is ~6 mm (Y≈±3) and the gate sits (Z≈9.5..15)
    x0, x1 = 60.5, 75.75
    z0, z1 = 9.2, 15.25

    # Trim positive and negative Y overhang beyond ±3.0, but only in the local gate region.
    cutter_y_pos = make_box_from_minmax(x0, x1, 3.0, 8.6, z0, z1)
    cutter_y_neg = make_box_from_minmax(x0, x1, -8.6, -3.0, z0, z1)

    # Trim any overhang above Z=15.0 locally (this should only hit the gate's tiny top sliver)
    cutter_z = make_box_from_minmax(64.0, 75.75, -3.6, 3.6, 15.0, 16.0)

    # Diagnostic: how much do these cutters intersect the current solid?
    for name, tool in [("cutter_y_pos", cutter_y_pos), ("cutter_y_neg", cutter_y_neg), ("cutter_z", cutter_z)]:
        try:
            inter = base.intersect(tool)
            print(f"INTERSECT: {name} volume={round(inter.Volume(), 6)} mm^3")
            bb = inter.BoundingBox()
            print(f"  {name} intersect bbox y=[{round(bb.ymin,6)},{round(bb.ymax,6)}] z=[{round(bb.zmin,6)},{round(bb.zmax,6)}] x=[{round(bb.xmin,6)},{round(bb.xmax,6)}]")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"INTERSECT: {name} ERROR: {e}")

    # Apply cuts
    out = base
    out = out.cut(cutter_y_pos)
    out = out.cut(cutter_y_neg)
    out = out.cut(cutter_z)

    # Report delta volume (sign + means net add vs the input-as-loaded; may be slightly negative since we're trimming excess)
    try:
        dv = out.Volume() - base.Volume()
        print("DELTA", round(dv, 6))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DELTA: ERROR computing volume delta: {e}")

    # Self-check bbox after trim
    bb1 = out.BoundingBox()
    print(
        "OUT BBOX:",
        {
            "xmin": round(bb1.xmin, 6), "xmax": round(bb1.xmax, 6),
            "ymin": round(bb1.ymin, 6), "ymax": round(bb1.ymax, 6),
            "zmin": round(bb1.zmin, 6), "zmax": round(bb1.zmax, 6),
        },
    )
    print("BBOX LIMIT CHECK:")
    print(f"  zmax - 15.0 = {round(bb1.zmax - 15.0, 6)} (must be <= 0)")

    # Isolate removed material (trimmed-off excess), for verification
    try:
        removed = base.cut(out)
        bb_r = removed.BoundingBox()
        c_r = removed.Center()
        print("REMOVED (trimmed excess):")
        print(f"  volume={round(removed.Volume(), 6)} mm^3")
        print(f"  center={[round(c_r.x,3), round(c_r.y,3), round(c_r.z,3)]}")
        print(f"  bbox: xmin={round(bb_r.xmin,6)} xmax={round(bb_r.xmax,6)} ymin={round(bb_r.ymin,6)} ymax={round(bb_r.ymax,6)} zmin={round(bb_r.zmin,6)} zmax={round(bb_r.zmax,6)}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"REMOVED: could not compute base.cut(out): {e}")

    return out
